title: Tiny, cute sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='nori' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3a3f6e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#22254a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='rice' cx='50%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffaf0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8ddc8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- nori outer sea-weed roll -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='40' fill='url(#nori)'/>
  <!-- inner rice -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='31' fill='url(#rice)'/>
  <!-- rice grain highlights -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='66' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- salmon-and-cucumber filling -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='52' rx='12' ry='13' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='52' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#ffb38a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='47' r='5' fill='#5fd06a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#5fd06a'/>
  <!-- cute face on the roll -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='50' r='3' fill='#2b2350'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='3' fill='#2b2350'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='57' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#ff9fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='57' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#ff9fb0'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 58 Q50 62 54 58' stroke='#2b2350' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
